activity.notes: Sanada Nobushige, popularly known as Yukimura, was not the sovereign ruler of a 'Sanada state'. His historically significant final role was as a senior commander defending Toyotomi Hideyori's Osaka regime during the winter and summer Osaka campaigns of 1614-1615. ATLAS therefore models him as serving the Toyotomi political-military remnant, not as ruling a clan polity.

sources.title: Sanada Yukimura — Osaka campaign summary
sources.citation_text: The campaign chronology documents Yukimura/Nobushige as a principal commander on the Osaka side in the 1614-1615 siege, ending with his death in the summer campaign.
